description: Sector overlay for manufacturing, processing, assembly, quality assurance, product safety, and regulated-product documentation in Nigeria.

metadata.scope: Nigeria-only sector overlay controls for Manufacturing. Intended to be used with core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis reviewed against official Nigerian statutes, regulations, regulator rules, codes, directives and standards current to 2026-08-30. This deterministic screening pack requires qualified human review before legal or regulatory reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Act, 2015 and current MANCAP/SONCAP conformity framework
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Republic of Nigeria / Standards Organisation of Nigeria

primary_sources.name: NESREA current environmental regulations, including applicable waste, chemicals and pollution-control instruments
primary_sources.issuer: National Environmental Standards and Regulations Enforcement Agency

primary_sources.name: FCCPA 2018 and FCCPC Mandatory Labelling of Manufactured Goods directive, 19 August 2026
primary_sources.issuer: Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission

primary_sources.name: NAFDAC current gazetted regulations for regulated products where applicable
primary_sources.issuer: National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control
